summary.oneLiner: Ghaziabad-based manufacturer of aluminium and copper-based electrical winding wires, conductors and cables supplying primarily to state-owned DISCOMs and private EPC/infrastructure entities.
summary.business: Incorporated in 2007, the Company manufactures aluminium and copper-based electrical winding wires, conductors and cables, including LT cables (including LT Aerial Bunched cables up to 1.1 kV), HT cables and Medium Voltage Covered Conductor (MVCC) cables, as well as winding aluminium/copper wires and strips and aluminium conductors. It supplies primarily to state-owned DISCOMs (via tender-based procurement) and private-sector EPC/infrastructure entities (via purchase orders), and also undertakes trading of aluminium wires and rods and job-work processing of winding wires and strips.
